description:
Decision D2 (approved): REPLACE the publication control plane. This item builds and shadows the replacement; dlv2-62 cuts over and retires the old plane.
Required design (from adversarial review; all mandatory):
1. Route manifest site/routes.yml: `/` (landing) and `/docs/` from the latest release tag; `/docs/dev/`, blog, and `/results/` (explorer UI + DuckDB snapshot) from trunk. Extend scripts/assemble_public_site.py (currently copies local build dirs only) to read the manifest and build each route from its pinned ref.
2. Candidate identity: only develop commits with a successful merge_group ci.yml run; record source SHA per route, corpus SHA, and the sha256 of the assembled artifact.
3. Pre-deploy gates (reuse existing scripts): scripts/publication/check_artifact_privacy.py, check_explorer_compat.py (both mixed-version orders; results-explorer/src/db.ts:289 rejects older snapshots), check_corpus_bijection.py, compare_db_digest.py, validator_parity.py, cross-route link check.
4. One serialized production writer: a single workflow with concurrency group, cancel-in-progress false, and a generation check that refuses a candidate older than the currently deployed one, tested with delayed and overlapping runs in both trigger orders.
5. Deploy via actions/deploy-pages with environment github-pages (reviewers kept; the agent approves pending deployments via API after gates pass, per standing approval). Explorer ordering: snapshot before UI; rollback UI before snapshot.
6. Post-deploy probes: fetch every route and verify served bytes/digests match the artifact (reuse scripts/publication/verify_live.py logic); write a durable receipt (deployment id, SHAs, artifact hash, probe results) as a GitHub Deployment status plus a retained workflow artifact.
7. Rollback job: redeploy an exact prior artifact by receipt, after verifying it is the last known good (probed green), then probe again.
8. Shadow: deploy to a non-production target (preview Pages site or artifact-only dry run with full probes against a local server) for >=5 working days alongside the existing plane; compare outputs.
